kind.description: Descriptive project kind. Must use a canonical value from vocabulary.json kinds; other values are reported as KIND_UNKNOWN. Kind never drives profile requirements.

profile.description: Governance profile driving required files, CI, OpenSpec and verification requirements. Must use a canonical value from vocabulary.json profiles.

capabilities.description: Optional capability declarations. Each key is a capability name (e.g. identity, admin, tenancy, billing, jobs, storage, release). Declarations are intent, not implementation evidence.

release_evidence.description: Optional release evidence record. Each field is one of revision, version, toolchain, artifacts, digests, sbom, provenance, checks, publication. Missing or unverified fields do not satisfy a deployable gate.

quality.description: Optional product-code quality policy consumed by scripts/product_code_quality.py. Declares product source roots, supported languages, exclusions, and the placeholder marker threshold.

product_roots.description: Repository-relative directories that count as product source. Each must exist and be a directory.

exclude.description: Repository-relative paths under any product root to exclude (generated, vendor, fixture, etc.). Exclusions must not escape the project root.

placeholder_threshold.description: Maximum number of placeholder markers (TODO, FIXME, etc.) tolerated across all product files before the check fails.

placeholder_markers.description: Override the default placeholder marker vocabulary. Words are matched case-insensitively with word boundaries.

language.description: A language profile supported by the product-code quality checker.

evidence_state.description: Lifecycle state of a capability or evidence field. declared: project intends to provide it. configured: artefacts exist locally. verified: native evidence recorded with a ref. unverified: missing or invalid evidence. blocked: explicit non-goal.

release_evidence_state.description: Lifecycle state of a release-evidence field. The 'blocked' state is reserved for capability declarations.

owner.description: Who owns the implementation: a platform repo id, a product name, or 'shared'.

evidence_ref.description: Repository-relative path to the native evidence artefact when evidence_state is 'configured' or 'verified'.

value.description: Field value: a string for revision/version/toolchain/provenance, an array of strings for checks, a list of digest references for digests/sbom, or omitted when only state is known.

evidence_ref.description: Repository-relative path to the native evidence artefact when state is 'configured' or 'verified'.
